description: This file defines the Exception class within the SuiteCRM project, extending PHP's built-in Exception class and adding custom behavior for SuiteCRM's exception handling, including custom constructor and additional methods for detailed messages and log level.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\Exception\Exception
classes.description: Custom exception class for SuiteCRM, extending PHP's built-in Exception and adding SuiteCRM-specific behavior and properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception message and code, prefixing the message with '[SuiteCRM]'.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Returns a string indicating that SuiteCRM has encountered an unhandled exception.

methods.name: getLogLevel
methods.description: Returns the log level (CRITICAL) for this exception to be used in logging.
